articles.title: Nvidia, Costco and Nike join pushback against OKX–ICE tokenized stock plans
articles.snippet: Nearly 70% of the companies initially picked for trading have opted out, while 19 firms including Apple, Tesla and Amazon have no disclosed objection as the 30-day response window nears its end.

articles.title: Anthropic swings to third quarter operating loss as compute costs surge ahead of IPO
articles.snippet: The Claude developer generated $17 billion in quarterly revenue, but higher computing costs resulted in a $567 million operating loss.

articles.title: Metals.io issues tokens backed by 25 tonnes of physical copper stored in Germany
articles.snippet: The company is starting with $366,000 worth of copper stored in Germany, hoping to build a market for investors to own and trade physical metal onchain.

articles.title: Strangers are begging the Binance hacker for bitcoin, one ‘help me bro’ at a time
articles.snippet: The 19 wallets holding 18,270 stolen BTC have taken in nothing since Thursday except payments worth under a dollar, each carrying a message, from pleas to laundering pitches to a token shill.

articles.title: Binance hackers begin swapping stolen Solana tokens for Bitcoin: Chainalysis
articles.snippet: Crypto exchange Gate said it froze two linked accounts as US investigators urged platforms to block transactions tied to the $6.3 billion theft.
